Gamma=sum P_i is a four-cycle by telescoping boundaries; alpha is a cocycle; alpha cap Gamma equals Sigma_{n-8}. The closed 2n-edge dual facet loop defines a 3-cocycle with odd evaluation on Sigma_0, which proves its nonzero class and hence a nonzero H1 cup H3->H4 product over F2. The packaged independent-of-n local verifier and finite computations complete with VERIFY_OK. No assumption that a mod-two computation proves integral ring or PL-manifold structure.
